client.credentialsHint: Client credentials are for the platform's own integrations only: their tokens belong to the platform (the default tenant), never to another tenant; a tenant's apps use the authorization code
client.redirectHint: Press Enter to add; HTTPS only, http://localhost for local testing
client.secretOnce: The secret is shown this once only: save it now. If it is lost, reset it.
client.copyFailed: Copying failed: select the text and copy it yourself
client.resetConfirm: The old secret stops working at once; apps using it need the new one. Reset the secret of {id}?
client.mcpHint: mcp and mcp.write are for agent clients only and start unticked: mcp lets the token call the read-only agent tools (MCP); only with mcp.write as well can it call write tools that add or change data for the user.

scope.user_read: Read your basic profile (username, name and avatar)
scope.mcp: Call the read-only agent tools (MCP) as you
scope.mcp_write: Call the write agent tools (MCP) as you, adding or changing data
